title: Show proof of accommodation
whatHappens: You need a valid address in Italy to get your visa — before you've ever seen the place. That's the paradox at the centre of this whole step: consulates want proof you have somewhere to live, but most landlords won't commit to a tenant they've never met, months in advance.
whoDecides: The consulate sets the requirement; finding a real, verifiable solution is on you.
timing: Needed at your consulate appointment — so before the visa step above, in practice.
whatCanGoWrong: This is where most students without support get stuck, or get scammed. See the housing section for how it usually goes wrong.
whatKimereDoes: We help you get a verified booking or a *dichiarazione di ospitalità* (a temporary hosting declaration) so your visa application can move forward while you finalise your real accommodation.
